overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Seattle 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is crafted from elegant Canadian Hemlock wood and features six strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels, providing soothing heat for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and enhanced circulation. With its advanced chromotherapy lighting and red light therapy, along with Bluetooth and MP3 connectivity, you can enjoy a personalized spa experience in spaces like basements or master baths. Easy to assemble and equipped with a clear tempered glass door, this sauna combines luxury and functionality for your ultimate comfort.
